verdict.rationale: The evidence shows pnpm keeps a single lockfile for the whole workspace, enforces it through frozen-lockfile mode in CI, and offers a dry-run install that reports what would change without writing to the lockfile. Nothing in the pack says the lockfile is text-based (e.g. YAML) or that its format is documented for agents to parse and diff. Missing for 10: evidence of a text/YAML lockfile format, first-party documentation of the lockfile schema, evidence that lockfile diffs are human- and agent-readable, independent hands-on corroboration.
